_comment: Asset contract: every mesh the city data places, with size, pivot and axes. Keys match Set/Kind in out/<city>/pcg/*.csv and ue5/Config/asset_map.json. Sizes are metres at Scale 1. Generated prompts: tools/asset_prompts.py. Delivered files are checked by tools/check_assets.py.

conventions.units: metres in source files (glTF), centimetres after UE import
conventions.forward: UE +X is the 'forward' named in each entry; yaw in the CSV turns +X to the given direction
conventions.naming: SM_<set>_<kind>_v<n> for props, SM_<archetype>_<module>_v<n> for kits; textures T_<name>_{BaseColor,Normal,ORM}
conventions.materials: PBR metal/rough, ORM packed (R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic)
conventions.texel_density: ~512 px/m for props near the player, 256 px/m for facades and large props
conventions.lods: Nanite for opaque meshes marked nanite=true; others need LOD0-LOD2 (100/50/25%)
conventions.file_format: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), one asset per file, pivot as specified, applied transforms
conventions.licence: every file needs an entry in game/assets/sources.json (source, author, licence, url)
conventions.axes: Same frame as the city tiles. In Blender: +X = the entry's 'forward', +Z up (Blender +Y becomes UE -Y). In the .glb (exported '+Y up'): +X forward, +Y up, +Z = UE +Y. tools/check_assets.py reads the glb in this frame. If the first UE import shows props turned, fix it once with yaw_offset_deg in ue5/Config/asset_map.json.
conventions.route: generate = imagegen ref sheet -> image-to-3D -> cleanup; hand = Blender/PCG/spline; hand_vegetation = UE Procedural Vegetation Editor or Blender with photographed bark/leaf; reuse_or_hand = CC0/CC-BY model if one fits (docs/08), else hand; hand_mesh_generated_print = simple frame mesh, generated background print, text rendered in UE. Kits are hand-modelled on the module grid.

props.forward: +X along the track
props.look_en: one 24 m module of a Hanoi elevated metro station straddling the viaduct: concourse floor at +7 m on paired columns, side platforms at +13 m under a long arched roof, glass-and-louvre side walls, escalator/stair towers coming down to the pavement on both sides; variant 0 = line 2A (dark green-grey curved roof, beige concrete, red-brown trim), variant 1 = line 3 (white steel wave roof, light grey cladding, blue trim); station name board left blank for UE text
props.references_vi: Ga Cát Linh, ga Láng, ga Thượng Đình, ga Hà Đông (tuyến 2A); ga Cầu Giấy, ga Lê Đức Thọ, ga Cầu Diễn (tuyến 3)
props.note: a station = 4-6 modules placed end to end along the track; the viaduct_span continues through it

props.name_vi: Đoạn ray đường sắt khổ 1 m
props.pivot: center of the top of the sleepers at x=0; the piece runs from x=-0.5 to x=+0.5 along +X
props.forward: +X along the rails; only X is scaled (Scale = segment length in metres)
props.look_en: 1 m piece of Vietnamese metre-gauge railway: two rusty-brown rails 1000 mm apart on concrete sleepers (variant 0) or old wooden sleepers (variant 1), grey ballast, ties, oil-stained; through a Hanoi street the rail runs flush with houses on both sides and locals put plant pots and stools next to it
props.references_vi: Phố đường tàu Phùng Hưng–Trần Phú, đường Lê Duẩn, Giải Phóng, Khâm Thiên, ga Long Biên
props.note: author as a 1 m long piece whose ends meet seamlessly

props.pivot: base_center of the barrier post; the boom extends along +X when lowered
props.forward: +X along the rails (the boom lies across the road, parallel to the track)
props.look_en: Vietnamese railway level-crossing barrier: a hand-cranked or sliding steel boom painted red and white stripes with a mesh skirt, concrete post with a red lamp and bell, a 'DỪNG LẠI QUAN SÁT' style warning post left blank for UE text, small guard hut with blue door beside it
props.references_vi: Chắn tàu Khâm Thiên, Lê Duẩn–Trần Hưng Đạo, Giải Phóng–Trường Chinh, Phú Diễn, Cổ Nhuế
props.note: boom is a separate socketed mesh so UE can swing it; the hut is included in the mesh

props.pivot: center of the bottom face at x=0; the piece runs from x=-0.5 to x=+0.5 along +X
props.forward: +X along the dike; only X is scaled (Scale = segment length in metres); +Y faces the city-side road
props.look_en: 1 m piece of the Hanoi Red River flood wall on the city-side of the dike road: reinforced-concrete wall 2.6 m tall with a 0.5 m coping, pilaster every 4 m; variant 0 = bare grey concrete with moss and posters, variant 1 = covered by the 'Con đường gốm sứ' ceramic mosaic mural (colourful glazed tile fragments, folk-art motifs, no text), variant 2 = painted flood-level marks and wall-mounted cable trays
props.references_vi: Đường Trần Quang Khải–Trần Nhật Duật, Yên Phụ, Âu Cơ, Nghi Tàm, Bạch Đằng, Lĩnh Nam
props.note: author as a 1 m piece whose ends meet seamlessly; the mosaic variant tiles over 4 m

props.pivot: base_center on the dike-road level at the opening centre
props.forward: +X toward the river (outside the dike)
props.look_en: opening through the Hanoi Red River flood wall for a road down to the riverside wards: two massive concrete abutments with slots for steel flood stop-logs, a steel sliding flood gate parked open on one side, a blue 'CỬA KHẨU' sign plate left blank for UE text, a guard kiosk and sandbag heap
props.references_vi: Cửa khẩu An Dương, Chương Dương Độ, Tân Ấp, Vạn Kiếp, Lĩnh Nam

props.pivot: center of the top edge of the steps, on the dike crest
props.forward: +X down the slope (toward the lower ground)
props.look_en: concrete stair down the grass slope of the Red River dike in Hanoi: 18-20 wide treads with a low parapet, cracked and mossy, variant 1 with a steel pipe handrail and a motorbike ramp beside the steps
props.references_vi: Dốc đê Yên Phụ, An Dương, Phúc Xá, bãi giữa sông Hồng, Ngọc Thụy (Long Biên)

props.pivot: center of the bottom face at x=0; the module runs from x=-1 to x=+1 along +X
props.forward: +X along the shore; only X is scaled (Scale = length / 2 m); +Y faces the water
props.look_en: 2 m module of a Hanoi lakeside balustrade: variant 0 = white-painted concrete baluster rail of Hồ Tây on Thanh Niên road, variant 1 = low grey granite kerb with iron chain posts of Hồ Gươm, variant 2 = green steel pipe railing with concrete posts of the newer lakes (Linh Đàm, Văn Quán); mossy base, fishing line tangles on the top rail
props.references_vi: Đường Thanh Niên, Trích Sài, Trúc Bạch, Hồ Gươm, Hồ Linh Đàm
props.note: author as a 2 m piece whose ends meet seamlessly

props.pivot: center of the hull at the water line (z=0 is the water surface)
props.forward: +X = bow (swan head)
props.look_en: fibreglass swan-shaped two-seat pedal boat as rented on Hanoi park lakes: white hull with a tall swan neck and head at the bow, faded pink or yellow seats, chipped paint, green algae at the water line, numbered hull with a fictional 2-digit number; variants = white, pink, blue
props.references_vi: Hồ Bảy Mẫu (công viên Thống Nhất), hồ Thủ Lệ, hồ Trúc Bạch, công viên Yên Sở

props.pivot: center of the patch at the water line (z=0 is the water surface)
props.forward: any (rotated randomly)
props.look_en: 4 m patch of pink lotus (Nelumbo nucifera) and water lily on a Hanoi lake: large upright and floating round leaves, pink buds and open flowers on tall stems, brown seed pods, a few yellowed leaves; variant 0 = full bloom (June), variant 1 = buds, variant 2 = late season with seed pods
props.references_vi: Đầm sen Hồ Tây (Quảng Bá, Nhật Tân), hồ Trúc Bạch, hồ Linh Đàm
props.wind: UE Pivot Painter or SpeedTree wind

props.name_vi: Ghế đá có giàn hoa giấy
props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X faces the water
props.look_en: grey stone bench of a Hanoi lakeside promenade under a small welded-steel pergola overgrown with magenta bougainvillea (hoa giấy); variant 1 with a climbing jasmine instead; peeling green paint on the steel, fallen petals on the seat
props.references_vi: Hồ Trúc Bạch, đường Thanh Niên, hồ Thiền Quang, hồ Văn Quán

props.pivot: base_center under the stool; rods extend along +X over the water
props.forward: +X toward the water
props.look_en: Hanoi lakeside angler's spot: a folding camp stool or small plastic stool, two long telescopic rods on an aluminium rod rest pointing over the water, a bait bucket, a cloth bag, a thermos; variants = different stools and umbrella on one; the angler is a separate character, not part of the mesh
props.references_vi: Hồ Tây (Quảng Bá, Nhật Tân), hồ Linh Đàm, hồ Định Công, hồ Yên Sở

props.pivot: base_center of the steel stand
props.forward: +X = tank axis
props.look_en: horizontal stainless-steel domestic water tank on a galvanised steel stand as seen on every Hanoi roof: ribbed cylinder 1-2 m3, domed ends, overflow and inlet pipes with a float valve, rust streaks under the stand feet, no brand lettering; variants = 1 m3, 1.5 m3, pair of tanks
props.references_vi: Mái nhà tập thể Kim Liên, Thành Công, nhà ống phố Khương Trung, Cầu Giấy

props.name_vi: Máy nước nóng năng lượng mặt trời
props.pivot: base_center of the frame
props.forward: +X = downhill side of the tilted tube panel
props.look_en: rooftop solar water heater of the type common in Hanoi: a rack of 15-20 black evacuated glass tubes tilted at 30-40 degrees with a horizontal stainless tank on top, galvanised frame, dusty tubes; variant 1 is smaller with 12 tubes
props.references_vi: Mái nhà liền kề KĐT Văn Quán, Việt Hưng, Mỹ Đình, Cổ Nhuế

props.pivot: center of the back face, on the wall plane
props.forward: +X out of the wall (fans blow +X); Y along the facade
props.look_en: cluster of 3-5 split air-conditioner outdoor units on rusty wall brackets stacked on a Hanoi facade: grey plastic casings yellowed and dirt-stained, copper pipes wrapped in cracked white tape, drip hoses, a bundle of cables, one unit under a corrugated-iron hood; variants = 3, 4, 5 units and a two-column stack
props.references_vi: Mặt sau nhà tập thể Thành Công, Nguyễn Công Trứ; ngõ Khương Trung, Trung Kính, Hà Đông

props.name_vi: Cổng khu đô thị có barie
props.pivot: base_center on the road axis
props.forward: +X = direction of entry (into the compound)
props.look_en: entrance gate of a Hanoi gated residential compound: stone-clad portal frame over the road, central guard booth with glass windows and a uniformed-guard chair, one boom barrier per lane with 'STOP' lollipop sign, speed hump, planters with ornamental palms, name board left blank for UE text; variant 1 = cheaper version with a steel sliding gate and a tin-roof guard hut
props.references_vi: Times City, Royal City, KĐT Linh Đàm, KĐT Mỹ Đình, KĐT Văn Quán, KĐT Việt Hưng

props.name_vi: Barie bãi đỗ xe tự động
props.pivot: base_center of the barrier housing
props.forward: +X faces the approaching car; the boom extends along +Y
props.look_en: automatic car-park boom barrier: orange or white steel housing, 4 m aluminium boom with red-white reflective stripes and a rubber bumper, loop detector plate, ticket post with a small screen and a 'DỪNG LẠI' plate left blank for UE text; variant 1 = boom raised
props.references_vi: Hầm xe Vincom Phạm Ngọc Thạch, bãi xe Keangnam, Mỹ Đình, The Manor, KĐT Dương Nội

props.pivot: center of the bottom edge at x=0; the panel runs from x=-1.2 to x=+1.2 along +X
props.forward: +X along the fence; only X is scaled (Scale = length / 2.4 m); +Y faces the street (printed side)
props.look_en: 2.4 m panel of a Hanoi construction-site hoarding: corrugated galvanised steel sheet 2.6 m tall on a steel-tube frame, variant 0 = painted blue with white band, variant 1 = green, variant 2 = covered with a weathered vinyl print of a luxury high-rise rendering and palm trees (no text), mud splashes at the foot, loose sheet corners
props.references_vi: Công trường Phạm Hùng, Tây Hồ Tây, Dương Nội, Linh Đàm, Vành Đai 3
props.texture_atlas: print slot uses one 1:1 graphic per variant tiled every 4 panels; prompt it by hand (not in prompts.jsonl)

props.pivot: base_center of the foundation block
props.forward: +X along the jib (counter-jib points -X)
props.look_en: hammerhead tower crane on a Hanoi high-rise site: yellow-painted lattice mast 55 m, 60 m jib with trolley and hook block, counterweight slabs, operator cab, red aircraft warning lamp, Vietnamese red flag on the cab roof, no company lettering
props.references_vi: Công trường Tây Hồ Tây, Phạm Hùng, Minh Khai (Hai Bà Trưng), Dương Nội, Vành Đai 3
props.note: the jib is a separate socketed mesh so UE can slew it slowly

props.pivot: base_center under the mid-span, on the road surface
props.forward: +X along the road (the stairs run along the pavements); Y spans across the road
props.look_en: steel pedestrian footbridge over a Hanoi arterial road: 32 m truss span on two circular concrete columns, 5 m clearance, green-painted steel railings 1.4 m high with mesh, a curved polycarbonate roof, L-shaped stairs on both pavements, motorbike-blocking bollards at the stair foot, posters pasted on the columns; variant 1 = older unroofed type with blue railings
props.references_vi: Cầu vượt bộ hành Xuân Thủy, Nguyễn Trãi (ĐH Khoa học Tự nhiên), Giải Phóng (Bạch Mai), Trần Duy Hưng, Hồ Tùng Mậu

props.pivot: base_center of the single steel pole
props.forward: +X = face direction (toward oncoming traffic)
props.look_en: large roadside advertising billboard (pano) on a single 9 m steel monopole with a 12 x 6 m panel on top, steel catwalk and floodlights along the lower edge, printed vinyl face; variant 0 = single face, variant 1 = V-shaped double face, variant 2 = facing both ways on a rooftop frame
props.references_vi: Ngã Tư Sở, Phạm Hùng, Khuất Duy Tiến, Giải Phóng, Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Võ Chí Công
props.texture_atlas: print slot uses a 2:1 graphic per variant; prompt it by hand like a sign print (not in prompts.jsonl); ad text is rendered in UE

props.pivot: base_center of the platform at road level
props.forward: +X faces the bus lane (doors side); Y along the road
props.look_en: Hanoi BRT median station: 20 m raised concrete platform 0.6 m above the road, grey-white steel frame with a flat roof, glass side walls with sliding platform doors, tinted end panels, a ramp and turnstile lobby at one end, route board and station name left blank for UE text, green and white colour scheme
props.references_vi: Tuyến BRT 01 Kim Mã–Yên Nghĩa: Giảng Võ, Láng Hạ, Lê Văn Lương, Tố Hữu, Hà Đông

props.pivot: center of the bottom face at x=0; the piece runs from x=-0.5 to x=+0.5 along +X
props.forward: +X along the road; only X is scaled (Scale = length in metres)
props.look_en: 1 m piece of a Hanoi central-reservation fence: vertical steel bars on a low concrete kerb, variant 0 = white and green paint, variant 1 = white and blue; dusty, dented, posters tied on with string
props.references_vi: Nguyễn Trãi, Giải Phóng, Xuân Thủy, Trần Duy Hưng, Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Quang Trung (Hà Đông)
props.note: author as a 1 m piece whose ends meet seamlessly

props.pivot: center of the back face, on the wall plane, at the floor slab
props.forward: +X out of the wall; Y along the facade
props.look_en: 'tiger cage' balcony extension bolted to a 1960s-80s Hanoi collective housing block: welded steel-bar cage 1.8 m deep cantilevered on angle-iron struts, closed with corrugated iron or asbestos sheet, sometimes bricked and plastered, laundry on a rod, plant pots, a bird cage, an air-con unit; 6 variants = bare cage, half-sheeted, bricked, with awning, two-storey stack, rusted and sagging
props.references_vi: Khu tập thể Kim Liên, Trung Tự, Thành Công, Giảng Võ, Nguyễn Công Trứ, Thanh Xuân Bắc

props.pivot: center of the bracket, on the pole axis
props.forward: +X = direction the main horn points
props.look_en: ward public-address loudspeakers of Hanoi: a pair (variant 0) or triple (variant 1) of grey aluminium horn speakers on a steel bracket clamped to a utility pole, weathered, a twisted feed cable running down
props.references_vi: Cột điện ở Kim Liên, Thành Công, ngõ Khâm Thiên, làng Mễ Trì, Cổ Nhuế

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X faces the street (door side)
props.look_en: Hanoi distribution transformer station: a green-grey steel kiosk cabinet 3 x 2 m on a concrete plinth, louvred doors, insulated cable risers, a steel-mesh fence with a padlocked gate, a yellow triangle 'danger' skull plate (no text), posters and motorbike parking against the fence; variant 1 = pole-top transformer platform on two concrete poles with the cabinet below
props.references_vi: Ngõ Giảng Võ, Trung Tự, Nghĩa Tân, phố Hào Nam, Định Công

props.pivot: base_center on the road axis under the arch
props.forward: +X = direction into the village
props.look_en: northern-Vietnamese village gate now swallowed by Hanoi: brick-and-lime-plaster arch 3.5 m wide between two square pillars, a small tiled yin-yang roof with upturned corners on top, moulded panels with a blank name tablet (UE text) and blank vertical couplet strips, moss and faded ochre wash, a motorbike repair stall leaning on one pillar; variant 1 = triple-arch gate, variant 2 = plain pillar gate with a steel 'Làng văn hoá' banner frame
props.references_vi: Cổng làng Vạn Phúc (Hà Đông), làng Láng, Đông Ngạc, Cổ Nhuế, Nghi Tàm, Mễ Trì, Phú Đô
avoid: readable Chinese characters or Vietnamese text

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: any (rotated randomly)
props.look_en: communal village well of a Hanoi village: round laterite-stone or brick rim 3 m across and 0.8 m high, surrounding stone-flagged apron, moss and fern in the joints, a bucket on a rope, incense stubs in a small altar niche; variant 1 = square well with a tiled roof shelter
props.references_vi: Giếng làng Đông Ngạc, giếng Mễ Trì, giếng cổ làng Yên Phụ, Vạn Phúc, Phú Thượng

props.pivot: center of the bottom face at x=0; the module runs from x=-1 to x=+1 along +X
props.forward: +X along the pond edge; only X is scaled (Scale = length / 2 m); +Y faces the water
props.look_en: 2 m module of a village pond edge in Hanoi: variant 0 = carved grey-stone balustrade with lotus-bud posts, variant 1 = cheap concrete baluster rail painted white; algae stains at the base, a washing stone step at every 10 m
props.references_vi: Ao làng Vạn Phúc, Đông Ngạc, Xuân Đỉnh, Nhân Chính, Định Công, Mễ Trì
props.note: author as a 2 m piece whose ends meet seamlessly

props.pivot: base_center: trunk base at origin
props.forward: any (rotated randomly)
props.look_en: old banyan (Ficus benghalensis / Ficus elastica type) at the entrance of a Hanoi village: massive buttressed trunk, curtains of aerial roots some reaching the ground as secondary trunks, wide dense crown, red votive strips and a small incense altar between the roots, concrete bench ring around the base; tropical northern-Vietnam village tree
props.references_vi: Cây đa làng Láng, làng Vạn Phúc, Đông Ngạc, Phú Thượng, đền Quán Thánh
props.wind: UE Pivot Painter or SpeedTree wind
props.note: placed with Scale 0.8-1.2; author at the size given

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X = customer side
props.look_en: informal Hanoi street-market stall: galvanised-pipe frame with a sagging blue or orange tarpaulin, a folding table or wooden bench with plastic baskets, a hanging scale, a low plastic stool; 6 variants = vegetables, fish in basins, pork on a board, fruit, tofu and greens, dry goods; the seller is a separate character
props.references_vi: Chợ cóc ngõ Kim Liên, chợ Thành Công, chợ Nghĩa Tân, chợ Xanh (Cầu Giấy), chợ Hà Đông, chợ Phùng Khoang

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X = front of the cart
props.look_en: Hanoi sweet-soup (chè) pushcart: stainless-steel trolley with a glass case of coloured jars of beans, jelly, coconut, tapioca and fruit, an ice box, stacked plastic cups, a folded umbrella on a bracket; variants = jars and umbrella colours; the vendor is a separate character
props.references_vi: Cổng trường Chu Văn An, Hàng Bè, chợ Nhà Xanh, Nguyễn Trãi, Lê Thanh Nghị

props.name_vi: Xe đẩy bắp luộc / khoai nướng
props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X = front of the cart
props.look_en: Hanoi night-time pushcart selling boiled corn and grilled sweet potato: a steel trolley with a big aluminium pot on a charcoal brazier, a mesh grill with potatoes, a stack of corn cobs, a small kerosene lamp, plastic bags on a hook; variants = pot vs grill emphasis; the vendor is a separate character
props.references_vi: Đường Thanh Niên, Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Giải Phóng, cổng KTX Mễ Trì

props.name_vi: Xe ba gác chở đồng nát
props.pivot: ground under the midpoint of the rear wheels
props.forward: +X = front wheel direction
props.look_en: three-wheeled cargo tricycle of a Hanoi scrap collector: rusty welded frame with a flat rear bed, bicycle (variant 0) or motorbike (variant 1-2) front, piled high with flattened cardboard, sacks of cans and plastic bottles tied with rubber straps, a hand scale hanging off the side
props.references_vi: Phố Minh Khai, Đê La Thành, Cầu Giấy, Trương Định, Phùng Khoang

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X = opening side
props.look_en: small votive-paper burner kept outside Hanoi shops and houses for the 1st and 15th lunar day: a cylindrical sheet-steel or cast-iron drum with a conical mesh chimney, soot-blackened, ash and half-burnt gold-paper around the foot; variant 1 = brick-built type with a tin roof
props.references_vi: Vỉa hè Hàng Mã, Hàng Bạc, ngõ Thổ Quan, Kim Liên, Định Công, Vạn Phúc

props.pivot: base_center
props.forward: +X faces the street
props.look_en: Hanoi public rubbish bins: variant 0 = green 240 L wheeled plastic bin with a 'bỏ rác' pictogram, variant 1 = orange-and-green two-compartment pedestal bin on a steel post, variant 2 = concrete-cast bin with a steel lid; overflowing bags, scuffed, no readable text
props.references_vi: Đường phố 12 quận: Trần Hưng Đạo, Xuân Thủy, Nguyễn Trãi, Giải Phóng, Quang Trung (Hà Đông)

props.pivot: ground under the midpoint of the wheels
props.forward: +X = handle side (pushed along +X)
props.look_en: green steel hand-pushed refuse cart used by Hanoi sanitation workers: 400-660 L body on four small wheels, hinged lid, a broom and shovel strapped to the side, bulging rubbish bags, worn green paint with a white band and no readable text; variant 1 = empty with lid open
props.references_vi: Góc phố Hàng Chiếu, Khâm Thiên, Trần Khát Chân, Cầu Giấy, Hà Đông lúc chiều tối

kit_rules.module_axes: front face on the X=0 plane facing +X; module runs from Y=0 to Y=width; base at Z=0. Balconies and signs may stick out up to +1.2 m in X, walls go back to -0.3 m
kit_rules.widths: the PCG kit picks the widest module set that fits each frontage edge from semantics/footprints_*.json, then fills the rest with smaller ones
kit_rules.ground_floor: shopfront edges get ground_* modules; other street edges get mid_* modules at ground level

district_sets._comment: Prop sets most needed per inner-city district (ids as in pipeline/districts.json); used to order asset work and to check PCG coverage per district.
